# Classless Wow Module

This module only works with the [Turor/azerothcore-wotlk-classless](https://github.com/Turor/azerothcore-wotlk-classless) fork (not stock AzerothCore). Clone the **core** with submodules; this repo is recorded on core `master` as `modules/mod-classless`.

Full first-time setup is in the repository root:

[English](../README.md) | [Español](README_ES.md)
